note.question: What role does unraveling the role of explainability play in human-artificial intelligence collaboration?
note.overview: Explainable artificial intelligence (AI) models have been proposed to mitigate overreliance and underreliance on AI, which reduce the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative tools. Yet, empirical evidence is mixed, and the impact of explainable AI on the cognitive effort and fatigue of a decision maker (DM) is often overlooked. This paper offers a theoretical perspective on these issues.
